what: overlay.py --image --codec prores on an 8-bit source composited the whole picture in RGB: rgb_chain_to_bt709() returned nothing on the ProRes line, so the RGBA still met the YUV main in overlay's format=auto, which converted the main to RGBA and back; a BT.709-tagged C03028 came out 356/413/771 for 320/440/768 (10-bit) away from the logo
escaped: the 3.6.0 fix (overlay_format) covered a main deeper than 8 bits; the 8-bit main on the ProRes line was listed as not re-checked on #470 and #696, and no test read a pixel outside the layer on that line
mechanism: decision.rgb_chain_to_bt709() converts the layer to YUV with the main's own matrix and range on the ProRes line (untagged read as BT.709), the one helper overlay --image and the emoji PNGs of caption.py and graphics.py end their chains with; test_an_rgba_still_on_the_prores_line_leaves_an_8_bit_main_alone reads the main picture and the logo on a tagged and an untagged 8-bit source
